name: Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries
summary: Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries, incorporated in 2022 in Dharashiv (Osmanabad), Maharashtra, makes jaggery powder, khandsari sugar, jaggery premixes sold under the Feel Guddy brand and sugarcane by-products, and began commercial operations in FY24. Revenue rose from ₹36.3 cr in FY24 to ₹75.3 cr in FY26 and profit after tax more than doubled to ₹11.6 cr in FY26, but jaggery powder is most of its sales and the top 10 customers made up 99.9% of revenue in the four months to July 2026. Debt to equity was 2.62 before the issue, and about ₹48.5 cr of the ₹93.66 cr fresh issue goes to repaying borrowings, with ₹23.5 cr for expanding crushing capacity. At the upper band the company is valued at about ₹268 cr, or about 23x FY26 earnings, above the median of the two listed peers named in the RHP.

fh1.finding: Revenue from operations rose from ₹36.28 cr in FY24 to ₹75.27 cr in FY26, a CAGR of about 44.0%.

fh2.finding: Revenue grew in both of the last 2 years: to ₹58.57 cr in FY25 and ₹75.27 cr in FY26.

fh3.finding: Debt to equity was 2.62 at July 2026 (borrowings ₹74.72 cr vs net worth ₹28.52 cr), down from 3.59 at March 2026.

fh4.finding: Borrowings rose about 17.7% (₹76.45 cr to ₹89.95 cr) over FY24–FY26, slower than revenue (about 107%).

fh5.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹12.98 cr (FY24), ₹18.48 cr (FY25), ₹25.07 cr (FY26) and ₹28.52 cr (July 2026).

fh6.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹5.04 cr in FY26, positive but only about 43% of PAT of ₹11.59 cr.

pr1.finding: Profit after tax grew about 110.7% in FY26, to ₹11.59 cr from ₹5.50 cr.

pr2.finding: PAT margin improved from 8.49% (FY24) to 9.39% (FY25) and 15.40% (FY26).

pr3.finding: Return on equity was 53.24% in FY26 (RoNW 46.24%).

pr5.finding: FY26 EBITDA margin of 27.19% and PAT margin of 15.40% are above both listed peers (Dhampure Specialty Sugars 12.20% / 9.50%, Dollex Agrotech 7.57% / 3.74%).

va1.finding: Post-issue P/E is about 23.1x at the upper band (₹267.61 cr market cap / FY26 PAT ₹11.59 cr), about 18% above the peer median of 19.52x (Dhampure 22.65x, Dollex 16.39x).

va2.finding: Post-issue price to book is about 2.2x (₹267.61 cr / ₹28.52 cr net worth plus ₹93.66 cr issue), but peer price-to-book figures were not stated in public sources.

va3.finding: Market cap to FY26 sales is about 3.6x, but peer market caps were not found for comparison.

va4.finding: Promoter Dattatray Kashinath Kulkarni received 10.00 lakh shares as a gift at nil consideration in January 2026, within 12 months of the IPO; no other pre-IPO placement is planned.

pg1.finding: Promoter and promoter group holding falls from 100% to 65% after the issue.

pg2.finding: The RHP reports no pledge of promoter shares.

pg3.finding: Related-party expenses were ₹1.63 cr in FY26, about 2.2% of revenue; promoters have also lent the company ₹25.45 cr in unsecured loans (34% of borrowings) and lease it factory and godown property.

pg4.finding: Seven tax cases involving ₹10.86 lakh are pending against the promoters; no criminal, SEBI or regulatory cases are reported against them.

is1.finding: The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 65.96 lakh shares, with no offer for sale.

is2.finding: The ₹93.66 cr issue is about 35% of the ₹267.61 cr post-issue market cap.

is3.finding: There is no offer for sale, so no selling shareholders.

up1.finding: ₹23.54 cr of the ₹93.66 cr issue (about 25%) goes to capex to expand crushing capacity from 1,250 to 2,000 tonnes a day.

up2.finding: ₹48.50 cr of the ₹93.66 cr issue (about 52%) goes to repaying or prepaying borrowings.

up3.finding: General corporate purposes are capped at the lower of 15% of gross proceeds or ₹10.00 cr, so at most about 10.7% of the ₹93.66 cr issue.

up4.finding: Proceeds will not repay loans from directors, promoters, the promoter group or group companies; the named lender is HDFC Bank.

lg1.finding: Six tax cases against the company total ₹28.75 lakh, about 1% of net worth of ₹28.52 cr; no material civil cases are reported.

lg2.finding: No criminal or regulatory cases against the company, promoters or directors, but an adjudication over a March 2024 private-placement filing is pending, with penalties of up to ₹2 lakh for the company.

lg3.finding: Contingent liability figures were not found in public sources.

rk1.finding: The top 10 customers made up 99.92% of revenue (top 5: 97.45%) in the four months to July 2026.

rk2.finding: The top 10 suppliers made up 3.03% of sugarcane purchases; cane is bought directly from farmers.

rk3.finding: The company was incorporated in June 2022 and began commercial operations in FY24, about 3–4 years ago.

rk4.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
